cards.title: Who worked the wire on Yahoo
cards.note: Adds and drops, and completed trades, across the eleven Yahoo seasons from 2008 to 2020, taken from the league's own Managers pages. Teams whose manager Yahoo kept hidden are left out.

cards.title: How the rules changed on Yahoo
cards.note: Every change the commissioner made that altered how the league plays, 2008 to 2020, with the date Yahoo recorded it. The rules page starts at 2021, so none of this appeared on the site before.
rows: An IR slot added to the roster
Draft moved from offline to live, and time per pick doubled to 2 minutes
Trade review moved from a league vote to the commissioner
Defensive yards allowed started scoring, from 5 points for under 100 down to -3 for 500 or more
Waivers moved to a continual rolling list, from reverse order of standings
Receptions started counting half a point each, having been worth nothing in every season before this
Field goals flattened: 40-49 and 50+ both cut to 3 points
Interceptions and fumbles lost both doubled, -1 to -2
Fractional points switched on. Every score before 2013 is a whole number
Playoff seeding changed: division winners now take the top seeds, instead of every team being seeded by overall record
Waivers turned off entirely, from a one-day wait
Missed field goals inside 20 yards set to -1
Passing touchdowns cut from 6 points to 4
Rushing yards moved to 0.1 a yard, 10 yards per point
Receiving yards moved to 0.1 a yard, 10 yards per point
